I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

Four allotments of land depicted as Lots ‘A’ to ‘D’, depicted inthe Advance Tracing No.: KU/BMK/2014/107 dated 19.09.2014,prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village calledHunukumbura in the Minor Division of Walgampattukorale in theDivisional Secretary’s Division of Bamunakotuwa in KurunegalaDistrict in North Western Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Udupitiya Kumbura – Extent: 0.0136 HectareNorth: Land claimed by Lionel Siriwardhane; East: Lot B; South:Balance portion of this land; West: Pradeshiya Sabha Road.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Udupitiya Kumbura – Extent: 0.0186 HectareNorth: Land claimed by Lionel Siriwardhane; East: Lot C; South:Balance portion of this land; West: Lot A.
03. Lot ‘C’ – Udupitiya Kumbura – Extent: 0.0056 HectareNorth: Land claimed by Sarath Jayaweera; East: Lot D; South:Balance portion of this land; West: Lot B.

04. Lot ‘D’ – Hitinawatta alias Kosgahamulawatta – Extent:0.0177 HectareNorth: Balance portion of this land; East: Land claimed by K. V.Piyadasa; South: Udupitiya Kumbura claimed by K. V. Thilakaratne;West: Lot C.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My No.: 4-3/8/2012/PC/370.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.14th February, 2018.
